segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to recap where we are: 62 seats for the analytics workspace, annual term, target go-live of March 18. Is that still the right scope on your side?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that's right. We may add five more seats after Q2, but I don't want to bake that into the first order. For March 18, we need admin training the week before.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Makes sense. I checked the pricing sheet before the call. For 62 seats, you're at $38 per seat per month on an annual commit, so the software total is $28,272 for the year. Implementation is the one-time $4,500 package.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Finance asked if the invoice can split the subscription and implementation into separate line items. Same invoice is fine, just needs to be clear for coding.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that's standard. I'll note that in the billing tool and on the order form. Payment terms are net 30 unless you need something else.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 works. Legal had one small thing on the renewal language. They want auto-renewal at 12 months with 30 days' notice, not 60.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it. Our template is 60, but 30 is usually fine for mid-market. I'll send that to deal desk today and should have a clean version by tomorrow afternoon.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Also, for go-live, we need your team to load the initial user list by March 12. We can send the CSV by March 7 if that helps.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I'll put March 7 for your CSV, March 12 for user load, admin training March 13, and go-live March 18. I'll include those milestones in the implementation notes.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send the updated order form when you have the 30-day notice language, and I'll route it for signature.
